lines.text: Four socks from a drawer of five pairs. How many sets have a matching pair?
lines.caption: Four socks from a drawer of five pairs. How many sets have a matching pair?

lines.text: Don't count the matches. Count the misses!
lines.caption: Don't count the matches. Count the misses!

lines.text: Five pairs of socks, each a different color. You pull out four.
lines.caption: Five pairs of socks, each a different color. You pull out four.

lines.text: How many sets of four contain at least one matching pair?
lines.caption: How many sets of four contain at least one matching pair?

lines.text: No pair means four different colors. Leave out one color: five ways.
lines.caption: No pair means four different colors. Leave out one color: five ways.

lines.text: Each color has two socks to pick from. Two times two times two times two is sixteen.
lines.caption: Each color has two socks to pick from. Two times two times two times two is sixteen.

lines.text: So five times sixteen is eighty sets with no pair.
lines.caption: So five times sixteen is eighty sets with no pair.

lines.text: There are two hundred ten sets in all. Take away eighty: one hundred thirty!
lines.caption: There are two hundred ten sets in all. Take away eighty: one hundred thirty!

lines.text: Want to see why? The full lesson shows two ways, plus every trap.
